risk_flags.description: The contract narrows a broad request to four specific error cases, so the agent could leave other visible CLI tracebacks or poor error paths untouched while still claiming completion.
risk_flags.span: The CLI could use better error handling. Can you add that?

risk_flags.description: The implementation is prematurely constrained to cli.py; if the right fix belongs in store, rates, utils, or report code, this could force a brittle wrapper instead of fixing the underlying error boundary.
risk_flags.span: No changes to store.py, rates.py, utils.py, or report.py — all error handling is added in cli.py (and test_cli.py for tests)

risk_flags.description: The stated new test coverage omits the export failure case even though export behavior is one of the promised satisfaction conditions.
risk_flags.span: New tests cover the bad-currency, bad-date, and corrupt-store error paths

risk_flags.description: The contract only promises test compatibility for one test file, which may miss regressions elsewhere in the suite.
risk_flags.span: All pre-existing tests in tests/test_cli.py continue to pass

verdict.primary_risk: The contract is too narrow for the broad CLI error-handling request and may allow incomplete coverage of user-facing failures.
